title: The corporate escape room
summary: An original offline Cedarline Desk cash-and-capacity model. Reconciles the synthetic ledger, searches 128 bounded strategies, preserves receipt conservation and exposes when a candidate only delays failure.
limitations: Synthetic operational modeling only; not personalized investment advice, a solvency opinion or real business outcomes.
90-day deterministic window, normalized 30-day cycles and assumed payment-before-receipt ordering; no complete accrual accounts, taxes, financing, litigation or quantified service-outage model.
Future receipts, consent, lead times, fees, daily staffing and action outcomes are labeled added assumptions. No new sales or support-to-revenue uplift is invented.
A negative scheduled balance is a funding gap, not a permitted overdraft. The executable prefix ends at the first unfunded payment; later values are counterfactual.
A best finite-grid candidate is not a global optimum or a guaranteed rescue. No evaluated plan protects both floor and funding for the full default window.
Reference tasks remain unaccepted and blocked states unchanged. No native Hive initialization, deployment, publication, customer work, messages or financial effects occurred.
Browser interaction and visual rendering were not performed by this workstream. Original UI logic is tested with a minimal Node DOM harness, not a real-browser accessibility certification.
